<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import re
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
# black intervals per row
def intervals(row):
    out=[]; s=None
    for i,ch in enumerate(row):
        if ch=='B' and s is None: s=i
        if ch!='B' and s is not None: out.append((s,i-1)); s=None
    if s is not None: out.append((s,len(row)-1))
    return out
for r in list(range(9,59,4)):
    print(r, intervals(a[r]))
print('nodes:')
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print(n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
for i in range(4):
    res=action(['RIGHT'])
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    print('RIGHT',i+1, sorted(out), res.get('board_changed'), res.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
